title: Attic
brief: Invent one new widget that goes beyond everything in the catalog. One remarkable idea, or none.

stamps.reason: The bridge prompt source covers a phone, a web client or a relay alike, so the widget cannot know the reader is on a phone, and its central moment cannot be proven without a live phone session.
stamps.subject: Pocket

stamps.reason: It is witness-widget pointed at a second source of hidden context, the same verbatim tally with a size, and its one new act, muting engine reminders, removes guidance at a risk out of proportion to the tokens saved.
stamps.subject: Nudges

stamps.reason: In a coding session an ask is usually answered by an edit or a command, not by a quotable sentence, so the quote test would list done work as unanswered, and the no-model splitter misses asks in prose.
stamps.subject: Unanswered

stamps.reason: A variation on lessons-widget's catching of phrases from prompts joined to stakes-widget's line under the dialog, holding what notes-widget and parking-widget already hold.
stamps.subject: Later

stamps.reason: A variation on situation-widget and playbook-widget, telling Claude a fact about the environment, and it measures a different shell from the one Claude's Bash tool runs, so its table can be wrong in the very case it exists for.
stamps.subject: Pins

stamps.reason: A novelty that is funny once: it keeps text the person chose to delete, and the longest-draft comparison cannot tell a change of mind from ordinary editing or a trimmed paste.
stamps.subject: Unsent

stamps.reason: A variation on theseus-widget, which already accounts for the lines Claude replaced from git history; adding authors and ages is a new column, not a new widget.
stamps.subject: Hands

stamps.reason: A phrase counter with a picture, in the family of mirror-widget and badges-widget, that changes nothing and tells the person nothing they do not already know.
stamps.subject: Swear Jar

stamps.reason: Attic is the only idea that does something no shipped or waiting widget can: it moves tool schemas in and out of every request from counted evidence, corrects itself, and reports a measured saving, with every call it needs present in the types file.

No blocking fault: every hook and call is in the types file, all main states are drawn and fit at 20 columns, demo and live sections are present, 108 lines and 15 acceptance lines; 12 notes for the machinist.

Built attic-widget: it counts tool calls per project, answers tool.describe from a plan made at session start to stow unused engine tools and forward daily deferred ones, with keep, stow, show and clear, the measured on-demand figure against a baseline, and 15 acceptance tests; checker, validator and type-check pass, the live run was not made.

1) After switching on mid-session no describe reaches the book, so after one tool call the card reads 'Every tool has been called here.' and '0 never called', which is false; keep the empty sentence until a described tool is recorded. 2) Describes raised before session.start are dropped (isOn is still false) and the A1 early test hides it by seeding isOn true; make the test real, handle the order, and name a live command that proves would-go rows appear in a session with an empty plan. 3) An empty or failed tool list is treated as having ToolSearch; it must be blind. 4) keep/stow remake every tool's move but invalidate only for the named one. Details in inspection.md.

Fixed all five findings in attic-widget: dry-run rows and would-go rows count only tools described this session (a call-only entry has seen 0), a describe before session.start reads the stored switch and is held for the merge, an empty or failed tool list is blind, a verb changes only the named tool's move, stow on a floor name always answers never put away and moves for absent tools are not counted; checker passes, no live run made. Live proof of the order, two runs: (1) bun factory/tools/live.ts factory/floor/plugins/attic-widget --say "/attic-widget on"  (2) bun factory/tools/live.ts factory/floor/plugins/attic-widget --say "Call ToolSearch once with the query select:Skill, then answer with the one word ok." --say "/attic-widget show" --say "/attic-widget clear" --say "/attic-widget off" ; show in run 2 must print would go rows with no verb having moved a tool.

1) The tool.describe hook reads the stored switch on every describe while off and sets isOn, so a session left off is switched on by a describe after another session turns Attic on: card appears, plan never made, stow writes the unnamed store key 'book:'; read the stored switch only before session.start has run, once, and test it under A13. 2) keep on an on-demand tool with no describe recorded this session (every mid-session switch-on) makes no move and no invalidate yet answers 'stays listed.' and shows 'kept'; invalidate, forward it when its describe arrives deferred, and do not claim it before. 3) Two small wording points. Details in inspection.md.

Fixed the three findings in attic-widget with no new state field: the describe hook reads the stored switch only while the isOn state value has never been written (version 0) and writes it then, and session.start always writes it, so an off session is never woken after session.start and the store is read at most once; keep on a tool with no describe this session invalidates once, a deferred describe of a kept tool sets its move to forward and answers isDeferred false, and show prints kept only for a tool the book knows as listed; the dry-run never-called count includes stowed and kept tools, and a key with no last segment prints the key or /; checker passes, no live run made.

Third build meets the spec, the standard and the bar: the hook no longer wakes an off session, keep forwards an unseen on-demand tool, checker and probes pass, and the live runs show real describes recorded and the on-demand figure rising 0.9k when Skill is stowed; four small points recorded in inspection.md.
On the demo page, in the README and the marketplace; smoke test clean
